name: Battle

components.pose: She leaps mid-air with her weapon swept behind her and her free hand flung forward, wings spread wide, a calm, fierce gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A surge of living vines, leaves and petals bursts out from her free hand, tearing banners and debris sideways, {{MAGIC}} light marking the currents.

notes: BATTLE: war gear and a weapon in a battlefield setting, commanding her element.
